gen-gf-bellota-gf-gudea: Distinctive and commanding, Bellota traces every stroke at one stylus width, its s ends dangling loose from the stem. Gudea's thread-thin curves and glass-clear gaps keep paragraphs moving easily.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-hanken-grotesk: Hanken Grotesk looks bent from a single wire, with wide channels into every counter, while Bellota lets its s ends hang loose. Up top, the display face announces; down below, the wire-bent text keeps quiet.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-hubot-sans: Bellota traces every stroke at one stylus width, so its o becomes a ring with a constant wall. Hubot Sans lays down a contemporary sans-serif body, its e opened wide.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: One stylus, no flicker: Bellota traces every stroke at a single width, with s ends that hang loose. And IBM Plex Sans Arabic, with easily readable open apertures, carries long text without fuss.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Bellota draws every line with a steady, unvarying stylus weight. IBM Plex Sans Hebrew, a sans-serif with open, uncrowded mouths on the s and c, lets paragraphs unroll without strain.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP ends every curve in a clean, open gap, which keeps its sans-serif text approachable. And Bellota's monoline heading, drawn start to finish, makes that quiet text feel easy to settle into.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-imprima: Imprima reads smooth and tube-like, its terminals flaring outward. Bellota is the one to catch attention with its stylus-width strokes and hanging s ends, while Imprima keeps the text comfortable.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-istok-web: Commanding and distinctive, Bellota gives r, n and m arches that match their stems, all traced with a single stylus. Istok Web, a sans-serif of rounded letters with a clearly open side, makes long text move along comfortably.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-jost: Broad terminal gaps and a unit-width stroke make this body text feel light and open. Jost keeps its sans quiet under Bellota, whose hanging s ends and stylus-width lines do the announcing.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kantumruy-pro: Kantumruy Pro reads openly, its e eye turning clearly right and its letterforms free of hairlines or swells. And Bellota, all stylus-width strokes and loose-hanging s ends, supplies the commanding voice above it.
